_comment: Tool roles of the DV flow (docs/spec/dut-dv.md): compile the UVM testbench with the VIP and the RTL, run one UVM test. Written for Synopsys VCS (UVM from the VCS install; `{extra_args}` carries the VIP's compile options). `q3tui tools init` copies them into the project's config/tools.json, where they are yours to edit.

sim_uvm.description: compile the UVM DUT testbench, the VIP and the RTL with VCS (UVM from the VCS install)

run_uvm.description: run one UVM test; the UVM report summary gives UVM_ERROR / UVM_FATAL counts
